D: A basketball legend is pulled into a cartoon world to help Bugs Bunny and friends win a game against alien invaders.
P: Serve the drinks when Bugs hands round the water bottle marked Michael's secret stuff.
S: Baby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in garlic dill ranch dip cups
Baby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in cups over a herby ranch dip of sour cream, mayo, garlic, dill and chives.
Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in paprika and corn chip crumbs
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into balls, coated in smoked paprika and crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs, served with crackers.
the alien theme park on Moron Mountain

Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips, brushed with egg and sprinkled with sesame, baked golden, with mustard and tomato sauce for dipping. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 24 strips. Wrap a strip around each of 24 cocktail franks, leaving the ends poking out. Lay on a lined tray seam side down, brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with small bowls of mild mustard and tomato sauce for dipping.
M: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on rolls under melted mozzarella
Beef and pork meatballs baked at 200C for 15 minutes, simmered in tomato sauce, piled into long rolls with mozzarella and grilled until bubbly.
Tenders and wedges, then the secret stuff

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp and golden, with honey mustard dip and crunchy paprika potato wedges. Cut 4 potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and paprika and roast at 220C for 35 minutes. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan. Lay on a lined tray, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 15 minutes, turning once. Mix 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp mild mustard and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for dipping.
W: Chocolate pudding cups with cookie crumbs and gummy worms
Dark chocolate pudding in cups, topped with crushed chocolate biscuits and gummy worms crawling out like little monsters.
K: Orange, lime, honey and mint with sparkling water, served in sports bottles

Fresh orange juice shaken with lime, honey and mint, topped with icy sparkling water and handed out in squeeze bottles labelled Secret Stuff. Squeeze 6 oranges and a lime into a jug. Stir in 2 tbsp honey until dissolved and add a handful of torn mint. Divide between 4 sports bottles, add ice and top each with 150ml cold sparkling water. Shake gently and write Secret Stuff on each bottle with a marker before handing them out at halftime.

Courtside meatball subs.veg: Mushroom and ricotta meatballs in tomato sauce on rolls under melted mozzarella

s.note: Baby carrots and cucumber sticks standing in garlic dill ranch dip cups
s.how: Mix 200ml sour cream, 100ml mayonnaise, a crushed garlic clove and chopped dill and chives into a ranch dip. Spoon some into the bottom of small cups. Stand baby carrots and cucumber sticks upright in each cup so everyone gets their own serve.

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese balls rolled in paprika and corn chip crumbs
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and 2 sliced spring onions. Roll into small balls and coat in smoked paprika mixed with crushed corn chips so they look like basketballs. Mark the lines with a chive or skewer and serve chilled with water crackers.

m.note: Beef and pork meatballs in tomato sauce on rolls under melted mozzarella
m.how: Mix 250g beef mince and 250g pork mince with salt, roll into balls and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Simmer in crushed tomatoes for 15 minutes. Pile into long rolls, cover with mozzarella and grill until bubbly, then finish with torn basil.

w.note: Chocolate pudding cups with cookie crumbs and gummy worms
w.how: Whisk 750ml milk, 3 tbsp cornflour and 80g sugar over heat until thick, then stir in 100g dark chocolate until smooth. Pour into cups and chill for 2 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and push in gummy worms so they look like they are crawling out.

d.note: Orange, lime, honey and mint with sparkling water, served in sports bottles
d.how: Squeeze 6 oranges and a lime into a jug. Stir in 2 tbsp honey until dissolved and add a handful of torn mint. Divide between 4 sports bottles, add ice and top each with 150ml cold sparkling water. Shake gently and write Secret Stuff on each bottle with a marker before handing them out at halftime.
